result.coreMessage: Trying a subscription feels low risk when you see the price per cup first and know you can skip or cancel.
result.visualDirection: Overhead photo of a calm kitchen table in soft morning light, two hands holding a plain light ceramic cup with light steam, small plain jug next to it, light wood surface and folded linen cloth, blurred background, no packaging, no text, no logos, no faces.
result.headlineDa: “Jeg startede, fordi jeg kunne stoppe igen”
result.headlineEn: “I started because I could stop again”
result.primaryTextDa: “Jeg så prisen pr. kop før jeg gik i gang. Jeg kan springe en uge over og opsige når jeg vil. Jeg kan se ristedato på posen.”
result.primaryTextEn: “I saw the price per cup before I started. I can skip a week and cancel when I want. I can see the roast date on the bag.”
